heading: top-center
name: 三欄滿版格線網格（直式圖片＋文字連結）
desc: 上方置中標題，下方三個等寬項目排成一列，由橫跨整個畫面寬的上下格線與欄間直線框成三格；每格是直式圖片加文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題下方是多個項目排成的網格，每列三個等寬、等高的項目，網格橫跨整個畫面寬、貼齊畫面左右邊緣，每格各佔畫面寬約三分之一，項目之間沒有間距。網格上緣和下緣各有一條橫向格線，從畫面左緣延伸到右緣；相鄰兩格之間有直向格線，從上緣橫線延伸到下緣橫線。每個項目無外框：直式圖片在上，寬度填滿格子的內容寬（左右內距相同，不偏向任一側），三張圖片同一比例；圖片下方是靠左的文字連結（可多行）。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：標題仍置中在上方，項目仍維持每列三個、直式圖片在上、文字連結在下，圖片填滿各欄寬度；取消所有橫向與直向格線，網格改為對齊頁面內容寬度，項目之間只留很小的間距。

en.name: Three-column full-bleed grid with grid lines (portrait image + text link)
en.desc: A centered title on top, with three equal-width items in a row below, framed into three cells by top and bottom grid lines spanning the full viewport width and vertical lines between columns; each cell holds a portrait image and a text link.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the title is a grid of multiple items, three equal-width, equal-height items per row; the grid spans the full viewport width, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport, each cell taking about one third of the viewport width, with no gap between items. The grid has a horizontal grid line along its top edge and another along its bottom edge, each running from the left edge of the viewport to the right edge; a vertical grid line runs between neighboring cells, from the top line to the bottom line. Each item has no frame: a portrait image on top, filling the full content width of the cell (equal inner padding on the left and right, not shifted to either side), with all three images in the same ratio; below the image is a left-aligned text link (may wrap to multiple lines).
en.mobile: Same structure, scaled proportionally: the title stays centered at the top, and items stay three per row with the portrait image on top and the text link below, each image filling its column width; all horizontal and vertical grid lines are removed, the grid aligns to the page content width instead, and only a small gap is left between items.
